have had close relations with Vladimir Putin.
That, combined with the fact that some Russian figures have been given a relatively easy ride in the Italian media in the last few weeks,
have helped create an environment in which most Italians say they're against sending arms to Ukraine.
And for a Russian president keen to exploit any divisions within the EU,
Italy is sometimes seen as one of the bloc's weakest links.

but it looks like it's accelerating.

do you see any action in the administration
